messages:
ben_sales: GlimmerCare RFI landed. They need: capability matrix, completed security questionnaire, POC scope + pricing, and an ops runbook. Deadline from buyer: next Wed COB. I attached the PDF they uploaded: https://drive.redwood/glimmercare/rfi_2024.pdf

tia_se: I can own the POC plan + capability matrix. Quick Q: do we offer on-prem HSM for Private deployments for this tier? They circled it in the sec questionnaire.

lucy_se: Yes we have KMS/HSM integrations for Private; need eng confirmation on supported HSM vendors and lead time for onprem package. Also need a simple table mapping features -> Dedicated vs Private vs Hosted.

mike_eng: We support customer-managed HSM via KMIP and can integrate with Azure KeyVault / AWS CloudHSM. On-prem package requires additional install prep (~2 engineers, 3 days) and network peering. I can draft the ops checklist.

omar_sec: I'll take the security questionnaire sections on data residency, encryption-in-flight/at-rest, audit logs, and SOC/FedRAMP posture. Note: we are not FedRAMP authorized; must call that out.

ben_sales: Good call. Buyer is in healthcare (PHI), so data residency and BAAs are deal-critical. Can legal confirm BAA language?@tia_se can you scope the POC to avoid PHI ingestion while we finalize BAA?

tia_se: Plan: 2-week sandbox POC, synthetic dataset, Dedicated capacity with KV cache enabled, basic latency/throughput tests, and 1 integration session for embedding calls. No PHI ingestion. Doable?

mike_eng: Yes — for realistic perf numbers we should use 8xA10G-equivalent for the Dedicated pool in the POC. I recommend quantization profile q4_0 for cost/latency balance. I'll add config snippet: ```gpu_pool: d8xa10g
model: redwood-open-1
quant: q4_0
batching: adaptive```

lucy_se: Pricing question from buyer: estimated monthly unit cost for their proposed volume (2M tokens/day). Can finance give a ballpark committed price for Dedicated + burst?

ben_sales: @lucy_se noted. Finance: we usually provide committed monthly for Dedicated; I'll ask for a conservative estimate but include a note that final quote is after model/hw selection.

omar_sec: Security note to include in RFI: retention controls, ability to disable logging per-tenant, ability to rotate keys on-demand, and audit log export to their SIEM. Will prepare answers and references to our compliance docs.

sec-bot: Incident report summary for last 12 months attached: https://internal.redwood/incidents/2024-summary.pdf :white_check_mark:

ben_sales: Great. Action items: tia_se to deliver capability matrix + POC doc by tomorrow noon; mike_eng to add ops checklist + config snippet; omar_sec to draft security answers; lucy_se to capture pricing asks and lead the quote. I'll compile and send the RFI response package to GlimmerCare legal. :thumbsup:

tia_se: On it. I'll attach the capability matrix draft here when ready.

mike_eng: Will upload ops-checklist and quick runbook link: https://playbooks.redwood/poc-runbook-glimmercare

lucy_se: Pricing note — will prepare two bands: 3-month reserved (discount) and month-to-month trial rate. ETA end of day.

ben_sales: Thanks team. If anyone hits blockers ping me. Need to avoid scope creep on the POC — keep it measurable (latency, tokens/sec, embedding throughput).

tia_se: Agreed. I'll include success criteria and test prompts.

lucy_se: Uploading draft capability matrix v1 now: https://drive.redwood/glimmercare/cap_matrix_v1.xlsx

ben_sales: Received. Will review after everyone's uploads and send to buyer by 18:00 PT tomorrow.
